style_lock: Style lock: warm editorial flat illustration with soft grain, rounded friendly shapes, gentle long shadows, lots of breathing room, one clear focal point. jobs.prompt:
Subject: A friendly indie maker stands at a large cork-style board on a warm studio wall, pinning a tall vertical card (2:3 shape) next to a neat grid of other tall cards showing simple pictures only: a planner page, a tidy desk with a laptop, a before-and-after split, a checklist with tick marks, a small phone screen. From several cards, thin dotted paths with tiny map-pin markers lead across the wall to three small friendly doors (helpful pages), and from one door a short path leads to the maker's tiny shop with a gift box on its step. A couple of small visitors follow the paths, holding a card they saved.
